stops.note: from a root meaning 'to share, revere, worship'
first recorded in 1832 in the Sanskritist Horace Hayman Wilson, who studied Indian religion as an East India Company surgeon in Calcutta
stops.meaning: a path of loving devotion to a personal deity

current_meaning: In Hinduism, a path of loving, personal devotion to a deity, central to the Bhakti movement.
